Car2 can't help because both roads out of Shivapuri hospital are impassable. Car1 therefore does all the driving, and every rescued person goes to Galchhi shelter.

| Trip (from and back to Galchhi) | Route | People rescued | Minutes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Belkot, Kalika, Likhu | 1 injured, 3 elderly | 104 |
| 2 | Belkot | 4 elderly | 46 |
| 3 | Belkot, Kalika | 4 adults | 64 |
| 4 | Naukunda, Gosaikunda | 4 children | 44 |
| 5 | Naukunda, Gosaikunda | 2 adults, 2 elderly (1 from Gosaikunda, 1 from Naukunda) | 44 |

**Who is deferred**
- **Thakre injured person (penalty 80):** Reaching Thakre adds 36 minutes to the Likhu trip and takes up a seat. That leaves one Likhu elderly person deferred (penalty 50), so the total comes to 428 rather than 422. Sending a second car trip to Likhu for that person instead is worse still.
- **2 Kalika adults (penalty 40):** Another Kalika trip costs 64 minutes, which is more than their 40 penalty.

**Cost:** 302 driving minutes + 120 in penalties = 422. I compared the main alternatives by hand and this was the cheapest, but I didn't run an exhaustive solver.
